title: Search the archive and create a collection
summary: Find synthetic media and organize a selection without moving the original.
prerequisites: Sign in with the built-in synthetic docs-reviewer account.
Archive and Collections must be enabled.

steps.title: Search archive
steps.instruction: Enter sunrise in Search archive and click Search.

steps.title: Create and add
steps.instruction: Select Synthetic Sunrise.svg, choose Add to collection, enter Demo selects and choose Create and add.

steps.title: Check the collection
steps.instruction: Open Collections and verify Demo selects contains one asset.

expected: Demo selects contains the selected synthetic asset. The source media remains in the archive.
recovery: If no result appears, check the exact search term sunrise and retry the search.
Collection creation requires a name and selected media. Select the result before creating.
